query: Genera un PDF Accenture da questi file di stima
expected_behavior: Reads every source file before writing content and cites, per section, which source document it was derived from
Produces the PDF at the requested path and reports the output path, the format and the file size
Final answer follows the 'Document generated / Format / Size / Sections produced / Source files read / Notes' block

query: Produci un Word brandizzato per il cliente da questi documenti di progetto
expected_behavior: Generates the .docx through a python-docx script and confirms the resulting path and size
Cover page carries project name, date, version and the Accenture copyright line, and the document control table is present
No source file is modified, deleted or overwritten

query: Trasforma questa proposta di architettura in un deliverable per il cliente
expected_behavior: Invents no estimate, no figure and no architecture detail absent from the sources: gaps are listed under Notes instead
Cloud service names are written precisely (for example 'Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL', not 'database') and the architecture section matches the component inventory table
Every risk appears in the risks table, not only in prose
